title: Post-assassination letters telling Ruth Paine to keep quiet about Oswald

tellings.quote: >> And Arthur Young's wife is telling Ruth, her daughter-in-law, ix nay on the Oswald gay, right?

plain: An author named Peter Levenda, on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, describes letters written after President Kennedy was shot in 1963 between Ruth Forbes Paine Young, wife of a man named Arthur Young, and her daughter-in-law Ruth Paine, who knew Lee Harvey Oswald, the man accused of the killing. Levenda says the older woman was telling Ruth Paine, in effect, to keep quiet about Oswald. If true, it would suggest people close to Oswald were being steered on what to say.
